description.zh: 在自己的几台 Windows 电脑和 Mac（Mac顺）之间同步剪贴板：文字、图片、文件，端到端加密，不用账号
description.en: Share the clipboard between your Windows PCs and Macs (Mac顺): text, pictures, files; end to end encrypted, no account

description.zh: 组里的设备、加入请求、别的设备复制的文件；附近的设备、复制邀请码
description.en: The group's devices, requests to join, files copied elsewhere; devices nearby, copy the invite code

hint.zh: 可以粘贴邀请码或输入地址
hint.en: paste an invite code or type an address

hint.zh: 别的设备看到的名字；留空用这台电脑的名字
hint.en: The name other devices see; empty for this PC's name

title.zh: 别的设备可以请求加入
title.en: Other devices may ask to join

hint.zh: 开着时，别的设备在「同步」里选这台电脑或输入它的地址就能请求加入，两边显示同一串 6 位数字时在这台上同意（和 Mac顺 一样）；关掉时要先在「同步」里选「允许新设备加入」
hint.en: On: another device can ask to join from sync (this PC nearby, or its address), and you agree here when both show the same six digits (as on Mac顺); off: choose Let a new device in under sync first

title.en: Put what comes on the clipboard

hint.zh: 别的设备复制的东西直接出现在这台电脑的剪贴板；关掉时只在「同步」里列出，按 Enter 才放进来
hint.en: What other devices copy lands on this PC's clipboard; off: it is only listed in sync, Enter puts it there

hint.zh: 在资源管理器里复制的文件，别的设备可以接收；收到的文件存在插件的数据文件夹里，7 天后或超过 2 GB 时清理
hint.en: Files copied in Explorer can be received on the other devices; what comes is kept in the plugin's data folder for 7 days, at most 2 GB

title.zh: 别的设备复制文件时提示
title.en: Tell me when files are copied elsewhere

hint.zh: 弹一条通知，点它打开「同步」：Enter 接收并复制，Ctrl+Enter 存到「下载」
hint.en: A notification; click it for sync: Enter receives and copies them, Ctrl+Enter saves them to Downloads

hint.zh: 0 表示都手动接收（默认，和 Mac顺 一样）；设了大小，别的设备复制的文件不超过这么大就自动收下、放进剪贴板
hint.en: 0: all received by hand (the default, as on Mac顺); with a size, files copied elsewhere up to it come by themselves onto the clipboard

hint.zh: 不在同一个网段（比如用 Tailscale）时，填组里设备的地址，例如 100.64.0.2；多个用逗号隔开
hint.en: For devices on another subnet (Tailscale, say): their addresses, like 100.64.0.2; several separated by commas

title.zh: 在哪些网络上广播自己
所有网络，包括公用网络
